learning_outcomes.text: Introduce the core machine learning algorithms, the principles and the mathematics behind them.
Be able to identify the best algorithm(s) for a particular task.
Evaluate and validate choices both experimentally and formally.
Understand the types of problems that machine learning algorithms can solve today.
Understand how ML algorithms are different from traditional programming algorithms.
Understand the role of humans in the development of effective ML solutions.
Gain a broad view about other types of machine learning, together with a general idea about the most recent approaches in machine learning.
Acquire and deepen oral and written communication skills.
Acquire and deepen critical reasoning skills.
Acquire and deepen group work skills.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: types of learning, tasks and data
Complementary aspects: semi-supervised learning, reinforcement learning, concept learning, fuzzy learning, sets, deep learning.
teaching_methods: TP classes: presentation and discussion of concepts, techniques and algorithms of computational learning.

PL classes: students practice using computational learning algorithms on the computer to solve problems of medium complexity, performing simulations potentially using tools. This work is done in groups, in the PL class, with the monitoring of the professor.
Out-of-class project with submission of a report and public defense.

assessment_methods.method: Resolution Problems (practical work in PL classes)

assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of 10% from resolution problems (practical work in PL classes), 30% from a project (with report and public defense), and 60% from a written exam.
